title: BEAUTY AND THE BIAS: EXPLORING THE IMPACT OF ATTRACTIVENESS ON MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing multimodal large language model (MLLM) selections in multiple-choice scenarios involving stereotyped jobs, traits, and conditions by presenting original facial images versus beautified versions (using beauty filters) of the same individuals.
Measuring differential model responses in binary-choice scenarios (particularly gender-stereotyped jobs) when prompted with images of male versus female faces.
Measuring differential model responses in binary-choice scenarios when prompted with images of young, middle-aged, and older individuals.

Measuring differential model responses in binary-choice scenarios (including race-stereotyped jobs) when prompted with images of individuals from diverse racial groups (Asian, Black, Indian, Latino, Mixed-race, White).
